name: mida-so
description: Run A/B tests and personalizations on your own site with Mida. Create experiments and goals, read results, conclude tests, and serve winners.

interface.longDescription: Mida is an A/B testing and personalization platform. A small JavaScript tag on your site puts visitors into variants and reports conversions. This plugin connects to your Mida account so you can build a test, launch it, read the result, conclude it, and roll the winner out without switching tabs.
defaultPrompt: What's running on the pricing page right now?
Create a test for a shorter signup form and preview variant B
Has the homepage hero test reached significance yet?
